svg.data-weight: 4.52 kg (9.97 lb) without power supplies or fan modules (Table 3)
svg.data-depth-with-power-supply: 382.4 mm (15.05 in.) with a power supply installed (Table 3)
svg.data-width-with-brackets: 482 mm (19 in.) with the mounting brackets attached (Table 3)
svg.data-poe-budget-w: 720 W with two 600 W supplies, 370 W with one (Table 1)
svg.data-poe-standard: PoE+ on all 24 ports, at most 30 W per port (Table 11)
svg.data-power-current-max: 8.5 A at 100 VAC and 4.25 A at 240 VAC (Table 19)
svg.data-altitude: no performance degradation up to 3048 m (10,000 ft) (Table 22)
svg.data-macsec: IEEE 802.1AE MACsec on all Gigabit and 10 Gigabit Ethernet ports, 88 Gbps of encryption
svg.data-virtual-chassis: up to 10 switches. The QSFP+ ports are Virtual Chassis ports by default
svg.data-uplink-ports: four SFP or SFP+ ports on the front and two QSFP+ ports on the rear
svg.data-optics-sfp-plus: the front uplink ports take SFP and SFP+ transceivers, singly or mixed. The supported list is in Juniper's Hardware Compatibility Tool, which the guide names and which is not held here
svg.data-optics-qsfp: the rear uplink ports take QSFP+ transceivers. The supported list is in Juniper's Hardware Compatibility Tool, which the guide names and which is not held here
svg.data-oob: management Ethernet RJ-45 on the rear panel, with a Link/Activity lamp and a Status lamp
svg.data-console: RJ-45 console on the rear panel and Mini-USB Type-B console on the front, both labelled CON
svg.data-usb: one USB port on the rear panel
svg.data-seismic: Complies with Zone 4 earthquake requirements per GR-63, Issue 4 (Table 22)
